description: Fichiers mensuels des données brutes de ponctualité - Maandelijkse bestanden met ruwe gegevens van stiptheid - Monthly raw punctuality data files is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Infrabel. Monthly files of raw data about arrival and departure of passenger trains (domestic and international) at their stopping points, over a day and by train number since January 2014. Delays are given in seconds. Negative delays represent a sooner-than-planned departure or arrival at the stopping point. The columns labels are explained hereunder. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in CSV. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are MMTIS. The portal shows 2024-12-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
